goal: Modernize the BabySteps design system with a reviewable DESIGN.md, bounded dependency adoption, shared design tokens and primitives, consistent accessible states across all nine routes, deterministic visual coverage at 375, 390, 430, and 1440 pixels, and bundle and Core Web Vitals non-regression evidence.

adopt: Use the existing @tanstack/react-query dependency for one bounded HTTP server-state slice in OwnerCompletionReviewPanel.
reject: Do not add react-hook-form or @hookform/resolvers for the current small controlled forms.
Do not add Motion or Framer Motion; retain accessible CSS motion with reduced-motion behavior.
Do not add a chart library without a demonstrated product requirement.

nonGoals: AWS Runtime or AWS resource changes
Blockchain behavior, contract calls, transaction semantics, or chain-state ownership changes
dataAndNetworkScope: Use repository fixtures and sanitized local evidence only.
Official read-only documentation may be consulted when thresholds or APIs require verification.
No production writes, AWS mutation, blockchain write, push, PR creation, or preview deployment before all gates pass and release is explicitly authorized.
context.release: PR and preview only after every deterministic gate passes; merge and production remain manual.

acceptanceCriteria: DESIGN.md defines the visual language, tokens, primitives, responsive rules, accessible interaction states, dependency decisions, ownership boundaries, and verification contract in Chinese or with an adjacent complete Chinese explanation.
The existing TanStack Query installation is used for exactly one initial HTTP server-state vertical slice without changing Wagmi-owned blockchain cache or transaction behavior.
Shared typed tokens and reusable primitives replace duplicated presentation rules without creating a second component tree for mobile.
All nine routes remain reachable and render coherent loading, empty, error, disabled, focus, reduced-motion, and success states where applicable.
Functional tests are written test-first for changed behavior and all focused and regression suites pass.
Type checking, production build, edge-SSR execution, GET and HEAD route semantics, asset/API passthrough, and unknown-document 404 gates pass.
BackstopJS uses reviewed deterministic baselines for 375, 390, 430, and 1440 pixel viewports; every scenario has no root horizontal overflow and no uncaught pageerror.
Accessibility checks cover keyboard operation, visible focus, semantic labels, status and alert announcements, contrast, reduced motion, and touch targets of at least 44 pixels.
Candidate route chunks and controlled-browser Core Web Vitals do not materially regress against a comparable frozen baseline; provenance, conditions, sample count, and confidence are recorded.
Secret, PII, private-path, public-content, link, and repository-policy scans pass before release.

An isolated review, Feature QA, Stop Hook ALLOW, local and remote repository policy, PR checks, and preview smoke verification are required before delivery is claimed; production release remains manual.
